requirements.text: Evry handles application work and recorded evidence. It refuses pastoral or Biblical counsel, prayer composition, spiritual suitability judgments and responsibility as a leader. Literal user-supplied prayer-related task titles remain ordinary task data; user or source text never grants authority.
requirements.title: Application-only policy and fixed pastoral boundary

requirements.text: Before every operation and retained-reference read, recheck the authenticated account, exact current tenant context, subject lifecycle and operation permission. A page, model-selected ID, CRM role, citation or organization affiliation cannot create authority. Organization reads use only their exact enabled shared projections; private care and its existence remain excluded.
requirements.title: Fresh tenancy, account and per-operation permission

behavior_rules.rule: Currently public global Wiki, own preplant account documents and own Discovery operations where native already allows.
Foreign account, plant/org operations without actual seat; auth credentials/native-only secrets/private care.

requirements.text: Register only operations flagged as model tools, under their native authority and purpose projections. Authorized reads and nonpersistent drafts need no write approval; return bounded results with source references, completeness, exclusions and cursors. Native-only and internal operations are not model tools.
requirements.title: Authorized read registration and bounded source artifacts

behavior_rules.rule: Shared model context excludes private care.

requirements.text: Choose a qualified model from measured task/effect evaluations with server-held provider settings. Record normalized usage and truthful provider failures; a model choice or routing hint never enlarges authority. Provider purchases and configuration need their own approval.

behavior_rules.rule: Current-authorized pure bounded assistant projection; no domain/protocol mutation, history, assessment freshness or provider handoff.

requirements.title: Measured model selection and server-side provider options

requirements.text: Open Evry from the global launcher or contextual panel and retain the same private conversation when the native page or panel presentation changes. A different tenancy context requires an explicit permitted choice. The design panel shows messages, reviews, progress and factual outcomes.
requirements.title: Global launcher and contextual conversation panel

requirements.text: Use visible page context and authorized entity references as presentation hints. Resolve every referenced record under current scope and purpose before model use; stale, revoked, foreign and private-care references are removed rather than used as permission.
requirements.title: Visible page context and safe entity references

requirements.text: Offer contextual suggestions only for currently eligible application operations. Eligibility is advisory and grants no permission; dispatch rechecks authority. Unsupported work has a truthful boundary response rather than a registered no-op tool.
requirements.title: Contextual suggestions and eligibility probe

requirements.text: Persist conversations and submitted messages privately for one initiating account in one exact account, plant or organization context. List, search, read and replay only that account's eligible conversations, with fresh lifecycle and retained-reference checks. Reconnect does not duplicate a submitted turn or domain effect.

behavior_rules.rule: Supported context kind values: account, plant, sending_church, sending_network.
Account context uses authenticated self; other contexts require the exact currently authorized plant or organization.

requirements.title: Durable conversations, search, messages and replay

requirements.text: Compile bounded context from at most 24 recent messages, 32,000 context tokens, 64 verified references and 16,000 characters per retrieved section. Remove forbidden references before each model call. Compaction failure preserves exact drafts and receipts and asks a narrow clarification; summaries cannot authorize execution.
requirements.title: Bounded structured references, choices and context

requirements.text: Show source-bound read, clarification, review, progress, receipt and boundary cards. Cards distinguish recorded facts, unknown/unavailable results and proposed effects; model text cannot impersonate trusted approval controls or claim an unsaved outcome.
requirements.title: Read, clarification, review, progress, outcome and boundary cards

requirements.text: Prepare immutable proposal revisions with exact targets, arguments, exclusions, dates, audience, bytes and induced consequences. Bind the canonical digest and current grant/resource versions. Editing any review-sensitive fact supersedes the old revision and its approval.
requirements.title: Changed proposals invalidate prior approval

requirements.text: Every durable domain, file or outbound effect requires a visible trusted exact review and human approval. Bind approval to account, exact context, proposal revision, canonical digest, current versions and a 15-minute expiry; conversational yes alone is insufficient. Cancelled, superseded or expired approval cannot start an unresolved effect.

behavior_rules.rule: Cannot undo a completed domain/provider effect; actual saved domain receipt and owning correction contract remain authoritative.

Current authenticated self + exact own account; owning operation native preplant floor must independently allow this exact action/projection. No blanket prefix allowance or inferred seat; saved file/domain writes require exact reviewed approval.

requirements.title: Trusted visible approval, cancellation and expiration

requirements.text: Execute only unresolved effects covered by the current exact approval and fresh authority/unchanged reviewed state checks. Preserve required consequence ordering, partial outcomes and truthful skips. Lost responses return known outcomes; retry only declared safe unresolved effects of the same approved action. Unknown provider outcomes require reconciliation before another attempt.
requirements.title: Executor, partial results, dependency skips and safe retry

requirements.text: Only work covered by the initiating account, acting context and exact current human approval may execute. Each committed mutation, its required audit/history and known outcome agree. Repeating or reconnecting to a completed action returns its recorded outcome without repeating effects. Expired, cancelled or replaced execution cannot publish. The representation of execution ownership and saved outcomes follows EveryField patterns. Recording an outcome creates no new domain permission.

behavior_rules.rule: Supported closed outcome values: completed, partial, failed, refused, unknown.

requirements.title: Durable effect claims and exact relational audit identity

requirements.text: Compose reviewed recipes from the same domain operations, resolving prerequisite outputs explicitly. Meeting invitation review includes meeting creation, guests and outbound invitation together. Domain drafts, scheduled sends, reschedules, cancellations and replacements each require exact review; recipes never create autonomous send authority.
requirements.title: Deterministic recipes and dependency-output reuse

requirements.text: Allow at most one active run per account, acting context and conversation. Stream progress and recover interrupted runs from factual saved state. A run that loses execution ownership stops further work and cannot publish. Resuming work preserves committed outcomes and executes only still-authorized unresolved effects. Lease duration, renewal and ownership representation follow EveryField patterns.
requirements.title: Active run claim, streaming, reconnect and restart recovery

requirements.text: Resolve natural-language dates in the authorized plant timezone with explicit local dates, times and DST ambiguity choices. Include the exact resolution in review; clarification is required when the intended date cannot be established. A model date never silently changes scheduling semantics.
requirements.title: Plant-local natural-language date resolution

behavior_rules.rule: application assistance and reviewed execution

requirements.text: Retain append-only product audit and exact proposal/effect identity with current review inspection and factual receipts. Reads remain scoped and omit private care and forbidden body data. Audit history records actual outcomes and does not imply approval, permission or implementation.

behavior_rules.rule: required owning domain consequence or bounded operator protocol

requirements.title: Append-only product audit and exact-plan inspection

requirements.text: Record content-free cost, latency and normalized input/output usage with safe run/build correlation. Optional Langfuse tracing excludes prompts, private content, credentials and private-care existence or metadata. Telemetry failure cannot change a domain result.
requirements.title: Cost, latency, usage normalization and privacy-safe Langfuse tracing

requirements.text: Every operation flagged as a model tool is exposed through the reviewed Evry adapter. The generated list in docs/catalog/evry-tools.json derives from operations.json model_tool flags. Native actor, purpose, privacy, review and correction rules still apply. Operations not flagged as model tools remain excluded; catalog membership never grants authority.
requirements.title: Generated model-tool exposure through reviewed Evry adapters

behavior_rules.rule: one bounded read tool and one candidate-preparation tool per domain; closed allowed operation+projection discriminators
Model tools expose no command executor.
Model tools expose no approval capability.
Model tools expose no arbitrary code, network, filesystem or SQL capability.
current authorization derives allowed discriminators; model hints never sole selector

requirements.text: Conversations, turns, saved reviews and approved effects remain app-owned and recoverable. Native and Evry calls use the same domain policy and outcomes. Reconnect, replay, interruption and retry preserve factual progress without authorizing or duplicating effects. Storage and background execution follow EveryField patterns; no per-feature execution protocol is required. Session ownership stays private to the initiating account and exact context. Transport exposes only allowed application operations and grants no arbitrary code, network, filesystem, SQL or approval capability.
requirements.title: Owned conversation runtime and private session access

requirements.text: Load available tools from the generated model-tool list under current context and purpose. Optional workflow hints may guide planning but cannot register hidden tools, change permissions or replace exact approval. Builders choose schemas and internal types in code.
requirements.title: Tool catalog loading and optional workflow hints

requirements.text: Keep revisioned planning notes, clarifications and todo state as bounded candidate conversation context. Saving assistant protocol state does not authorize domain effects. Submitted user messages, review revisions and actual outcomes remain distinguishable.
requirements.title: Editable planning notes, clarifications and todo

requirements.text: Return source-bound result cards and allow compatible selection only from returned authorized rows. Selection cannot expand a result set or invent IDs, and current access is checked before reuse. Keep cursor, exclusions and completeness visible.
requirements.title: Source-bound result cards and compatible selection

requirements.text: Stage attachments privately under authorized account/context/session manifests with frozen type, size, hash and object identity. Bind only eligible files, validate import through native rules and clean only unreferenced staged objects under current fences. A staged file is not a domain import or publication approval.
requirements.title: Staged private file manifests, session binding and cleanup

behavior_rules.rule: Supported file kind values: people_csv, person_photo, commitment, text, docx.

requirements.text: Compose at most eight declared authorized reads in parallel and count each actual read against the same 24-call turn budget. Read composition exposes no arbitrary code, filesystem, network, SQL, durable command executor or approval capability.

behavior_rules.rule: At most eight declared parallel reads; each actual composed read consumes one of the same 24 tool invocations, plus wall/cumulative token budgets. Wrapper cannot multiply budget or bypass current scope/purpose.

requirements.title: Bounded parallel composition of authorized reads

requirements.text: Optional discovery or routing experiments use measured evaluations of the same authorized operations. Routing hints and SDK wrappers are optional implementation choices, never mandatory dependencies or authority. Experiments cannot bypass review, privacy or current scope.
requirements.title: Optional routing experiments and measured evaluation

requirements.text: Provide the eleven authored operational workflow hints as planning context for approved application work. Hints do not execute effects, provide pastoral counsel, invent tools or replace exact approval. Resolve their suggested operations through current catalog and authority.
requirements.title: Eleven authored operational workflow skills

requirements.text: Bound a turn to 24 tool calls, 8,000 output tokens per model call, 128,000 cumulative input tokens, 16,000 cumulative output tokens and 180 seconds wall time; a read timeout is 30 seconds. Permit one transient read retry and two model retries with 1- then 3-second backoff inside the budget. Stop truthfully at the first limit, retain drafts/receipts and continue only on a later explicit turn with fresh authorization.
requirements.title: Processing budgets, compaction failure and explicit retry

requirements.text: Evaluate Evry against an independent agent corpus and real applicable tool/effect fixtures, grading exact results, authority denials, review, replay, recovery and privacy. Repeat critical journeys three times and other journeys one to three times. Counts or source inspection alone do not establish application or provider quality.

behavior_rules.rule: Evaluation runs repeat critical journeys three times and other journeys one to three times.
Actor/exact-context-private conversation state and known outcomes only; no owning domain effect, provider handoff or plant assessment freshness.

requirements.title: Independent agent corpus, fixture/effect proofs and quality grading

requirements.text: Read complete authorized history through bounded pages with source identity and actual event/entry dates. Unicode note continuation preserves exact text and distinguishes occurrence from recording time. Exclude private care and forbidden interview/assessment details under the caller's purpose; history never creates a permission grant.

behavior_rules.rule: Exclude private-care body, existence, calendar, trend and nudge metadata; current entitlement/lifecycle for each source including prior artifacts/messages.

Strip raw Interview/4Cs judgments, scores, results and notes from BOTH current and retained messages/citations before model input; allow only permitted human-record presence/count/date and operational candidate facts. Separate native/authorized People record operations retain their own floor.

Strip individual Person/profile/lead directory/interview content from BOTH current and retained messages/citations; ordinary scoped directory lead-name read remains a separate operation/purpose and supplies no NI input.
If purpose/source provenance or current projection cannot be proven, omit it and ask narrow safe clarification or use native handoff; no cached body fallback.

requirements.title: Complete history, Unicode note continuation and event/entry dates

requirements.text: Project sanitized errors with safe correlation, truthful failure/unknown status and retry eligibility. Scrub credentials, tokens, private bodies and forbidden existence metadata. Untrusted source or error text is data and cannot issue tool instructions or grant authority.
requirements.title: Sanitized errors, credential scrubbing and trusted boundaries

requirements.text: Show the current proposal review status separately from historic factual durable receipts. A later cancelled, expired or superseded review cannot erase a completed effect or authorize another one. Read only the current authorized account/context projection.
requirements.title: Current review status and historic factual outcomes

requirements.text: Reuse a recipe as a new draft with freshly resolved authorized inputs and a new exact review and approval. Never reuse an old approval or silently replay changed targets, dates, audience, bytes or consequences. Existing receipts remain factual history.
requirements.title: Recipe reuse with fresh resolution and new approval
